explanation: W = 1.4885 GeV is above the eta production threshold (1.4861 GeV) so the point is physically valid, but it sits within 10 MeV of threshold, a region where the EXCLURAD integrator is known to hang or silently return N/A instead of failing cleanly. The input file was generated anyway (preflight verdict: WARN, not FAIL), but a short-timeout smoke test is recommended before trusting the output or submitting this as part of a larger grid. Beam energy was not specified by the user, so it defaulted to 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K), the campaign the validated eta reference data came from; other CLAS12 energies (10.6 GeV RG-A, 10.2 GeV RG-B) would give different radiative corrections, so this choice should be stated when reporting results. vcut defaulted to 0.166 GeV^2 (channel default) and rc_mode to 'full' O(alpha).
